name: Tomato

moderate.description: One medium tomato, generally well tolerated

siboNotes: Tomatoes are generally safe for SIBO patients at normal serving sizes. Cherry tomatoes and roma tomatoes are also low FODMAP. Canned tomatoes may have added high-FODMAP ingredients, so check labels.
preparationTips: Fresh tomatoes are easiest to digest
Avoid tomato sauces with added onion or garlic
